results.corrected_extracted: As described: shared genetic vulnerability is a popular explanation; the polygenic risk score for schizophrenia accounted for only a very small proportion of cannabis use in a large Australian sample (Power et al., 2014), which the first reader notes is itself the shared-liability direction; the authors leave open whether cannabis can induce psychosis without genetic vulnerability.
